Build a NextGen hydrofabric from a single GeoPackage

Source: R/nextgen_from_gpkg.R
nextgen_from_gpkg.Rd

A self-contained function that reads all inputs–flowpaths, divides, network, pois, flowlines, and events–from a single GeoPackage produced by the add_flowlines step of the pipeline. No separate flowline_gpkg is required because add_flowlines writes full-resolution split segments (with id, toid, flowpath_id, areasqkm, fac_value, etc.) directly into the primary GeoPackage.

Usage

nextgen_from_gpkg(
  flowpath_gpkg,
  collapse_method = "upstream",
  nexus_prefix = "nex-",
  terminal_nexus_prefix = "tnx-",
  divide_prefix = "cat-",
  flowpath_prefix = "fp-",
  term_add = 1e+09,
  outfile = NULL
)

Arguments

flowpath_gpkg

Path to a GeoPackage containing at minimum: flowpaths, divides, network. Should also contain pois, flowlines (from add_flowlines), and events.

collapse_method

Character, "upstream" (default) or "downstream". Controls nexus ID keying at confluences. "upstream" keys the nexus on the receiving flowpath (nex-X where X = toid) so all donors to fp X share one nexus: fewer nexuses, shared at confluences. "downstream" keys the nexus on the donating flowpath (nex-X where X = flowpath_id) so each donor gets its own outlet nexus, one nexus per fp. Terminal nexuses are unaffected by this parameter.

nexus_prefix

Character prefix for nexus IDs. Default "nex-".

terminal_nexus_prefix

Prefix for terminal nexus IDs. Default "tnx-".

divide_prefix

Prefix for divide IDs. Default "cat-".

flowpath_prefix

Prefix for flowpath IDs. Default "fp-".

term_add

Numeric offset added to terminal flowpath_toid values. Default 1e9.

outfile

Optional path for output GeoPackage. If NULL (default) returns the list invisibly instead of writing.

Value

If outfile is specified, writes the result to that GeoPackage and returns NULL invisibly. Otherwise returns a named list with elements nexus, flowpaths, divides, flowlines, incremental_areas, pois (when present), and network.

Details

Topology steps:

  1. Build nexus geometries from flowpath endpoints.

  2. Identify terminal and headwater nexus nodes.

  3. Assign prefixed IDs to flowpaths, divides, and nexuses.

  4. Join the sub-flowline segments (from the flowlines layer) to their parent aggregated flowpaths via flowlines$flowpath_id.

  5. Compute flowline_incr (FAC-derived incremental drainage area in km2 per sub-flowline: total_dasqkm[i] - max(total_dasqkm[upstream donors])).

  6. Build incremental_areas from divides joined to flowlines.

  7. Join hydrolocations from the events layer into the network table.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
nextgen_from_gpkg("out_vpu01.gpkg", outfile = "ngen_vpu01.gpkg")
ng <- nextgen_from_gpkg("out_vpu01.gpkg")
} # }
